name: hcportal_getDeviceHealth
description: Per-device health for one user, for the Usage Data user tile. Extracts the [METRICS] instrumentation (app 3.0.14+) from the user's uploaded session logs in HC.ClientErrorLog: per session the last '[METRICS] why=' line before the ring block (cumulative summary), the first 'why=start' line, the [METRICS:PEAKS] line, the [METRICS:RING] block (every session), the first app error and the [ERROR] lines. The SP extracts lines; the portal parses key=value pairs, so new app fields need no SP change. Runs at READ UNCOMMITTED with NOLOCK hints. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (device-bound token, NULL callerParamString). No permission gate beyond authentication — any authenticated portal caller may query any @userId.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Required. The hasher whose app devices to report. NULL returns 'Null or invalid userId'.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days on ClientErrorLog.LoggedAt, default 14; NULL or outside 1–90 resets to 14.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Only on auth failure, NULL @userId, or a runtime error (the CATCH logs to HC.ErrorLog first). Replaces both data rowsets.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text, 'Null or invalid userId', or ERROR_MESSAGE()

rowsets.name: Devices
rowsets.description: The user's APP devices (HC.Device.removed = 0 and OperatingSystem 'iOS' or NULL — portal browser rows excluded) that uploaded at least one ClientErrorLog row in the window, most recent LastLogin first.

columns.name: deviceId
columns.description: HC.Device.id

columns.name: os
columns.description: HC.Device.OperatingSystem; NULL reads as 'Android' (the Android payload has no systemName)

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: Current 'X.Y.Z+build' of the device

columns.name: lastLogin
columns.description: HC.Device.LastLogin

columns.name: sessions
columns.description: App launches whose harvested log was uploaded in the window (MetricKit payload rows excluded)

columns.name: sessionsWithMetrics
columns.description: Of those, sessions carrying [METRICS] lines

columns.name: sessionsOnBuild
columns.description: Of those, launches whose log was written by the build the device runs now (AppVersion/BuildNumber match; pre-3.0.13 rows never match)

rowsets.name: Sessions
rowsets.description: TOP 60 harvested rows across those devices, newest LoggedAt first: every app-launch log, plus MetricKit rows only when HC6.ClientLogAppError finds a diagnostic in them.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: 'session' (an app launch's log) or 'diagnostic' (a MetricKit crash/hang payload; routine metric payloads are never listed)

columns.name: sessionStart
columns.description: The log's first entry timestamp (ISO, phone-local): when the session began. NULL if the log does not start with a timestamped entry.

columns.name: loggedAt
columns.description: Upload time (one boot after the session)

columns.name: deviceId
columns.description: Which device

columns.name: os
columns.description: 'iOS' or 'Android'

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: Build that wrote the log (falls back to the device's current build for pre-3.0.13 rows)

columns.name: summary
columns.description: NULL when the session carried no metrics (build before 3.0.14). Otherwise the text after the LAST '[METRICS] ' tag: the session's cumulative key=value summary (why up fg bg cpu cpu% rss peak pss avail db docs cache disk_free loc_* app_tx app_rx req fail lat_avg lat_max dev_rx dev_tx batt state Δ drain chg lpm therm)

columns.name: summaryStart
columns.description: Text after the FIRST '[METRICS] why=start' tag: the session's launch sample (batt, rss, avail …), so start and end can be compared

columns.name: peaks
columns.description: Text after '[METRICS:PEAKS]': key=value@HH:MM:SS extremes (rss_max avail_min cpu%_max lat_max batt_min pss_max)

columns.name: ring
columns.description: Every session that has one: the [METRICS:RING] block from its tag up to the peaks line — header 'rows=N every=60s cols=…' then one CSV row per line. The trailing fragment is the peaks line's timestamp; callers drop any line starting with '['.

columns.name: appError
columns.description: HC6.ClientLogAppError: first app-error line, or NULL

columns.name: errorLines
columns.description: Count of [ERROR] lines of any kind in the session

columns.name: errorText
columns.description: The [ERROR] lines themselves (first 60, each cut at 400 chars), newline-separated, in log order

sideEffects: On a runtime error only: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId))

codeSmells.issue: No permission gate on another user's logs
codeSmells.detail: After ValidatePortalAuth (line 53) the SP serves any @userId's device list and raw [ERROR] log text to any authenticated portal user; there is no PlatformAdmin / super-admin check. The portal only shows the tile to admins, but the SP itself does not enforce it.
Header (lines 25-27) says Sessions is TOP 100 and that the ring is returned for the latest session per device only; the body returns TOP 60 (line 121) and a ring for every session (line 151).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
summary/peaks/ring are the raw log text after the tag — the portal parses them; never pre-format them here
